versions.content: The RTE Generator shall create an unconditional call to the Os API Schedule after the execution of the Rte_Rips_FillFlushRoutine , if the RteRipsOsSchedulePoint configuration parameter is set to UNCONDITIONAL . In the generated code the call to the Os API Schedule shall only be performed when the Rte_Rips_FillFlushRoutine itself has been executed (called).
